ops.title: Reviewed broker rejects isolated Codex 0.156.1
ops.body:
The official isolated npm runtime at /tmp/codex-port-desktop-compat-01561/node_modules/.bin/codex resolved to @openai/codex/bin/codex.js and reported codex-cli 0.156.1. Its launcher SHA-256 was 61b0194f3bb6534439c8d26a3ed57d0805f84b884588b761795323eeb92fcf70; the native arm64 Mach-O runtime SHA-256 was 0196e89fe5a7598f816ee54232c3d7c26d75e502ab5cfe2c9240e81d90f7255a.

Reviewed broker candidate dddcfb463919538a6bc67bd15fd2cf1b36bc92afa7b73b98debd8d498d3de36e failed before TUI startup with the exact visible error: shared server requires validated codex-cli 0.155.1, got "codex-cli 0.156.1". The isolated registry had zero bindings, server.json was absent, no model prompt could be submitted, and no probe process remained.

This proves an explicit version-policy incompatibility in the launcher, not an observed Codex 0.156.1 protocol failure. Full command, hashes, evidence boundaries, and cleanup are attached from /tmp/codex-port-terminal-01561.txt.
